name: Face-driven avatar
description: An avatar from any reference image driven by the streamer's face (D295 proposed). Approach A (prototype, offline only): landmarks on the reference (or manual anchors), Delaunay triangulation and a piecewise-affine warp driven by the streamer's landmark deltas (head turn, blink, mouth, brows); services/face/avatar.py renders a recorded or synthetic landmark sequence to video. Approach B (LivePortrait-class neural reenactment) evaluated on paper only. Not wired into the host; live use needs the user's decision.
